metadata.description: Collection of specialized Claude Code agents and skills for development workflows

plugins.name: general
plugins.description: Language-agnostic agents for software architecture analysis (feature.yaml to technical.yaml pipeline), system design, and product specification

plugins.name: python-development
plugins.description: Python backend development agents and skills with Clean Architecture, FastAPI, Celery, library development, and Alembic migration jobs

plugins.name: flutter-development
plugins.description: Flutter and Dart development agents for mobile app development and code review with Clean Architecture, BLoC+Freezed, and Result<T> error handling

plugins.name: nextjs-development
plugins.description: Next.js development agents for two tracks: frontend-only apps with Two-layer Architecture, Zustand stores and Either monad error handling, and fullstack apps with Hexagonal Architecture, Route Handlers and Prisma (including a dedicated security reviewer)
